Accept both upstream Cargo-link rejections. Common damage dispatch separates carried victims from held items, and active HeavyLanding and CargoLanding registrations use different collision callbacks. Preserve supported heavy-item relationships without inheriting unconditional HeavyWait2-preservation explanations.
